labelChirho: to fine, impose a monetary penalty
descriptionChirho: Qal active: to fine or mulct someone, imposing a monetary penalty (Dt 22:19, 2Chr 36:3, Am 2:8)
Qal active: to punish in a general sense, not limited to monetary penalty (Pr 17:26, 21:11; Ex 21:22 infinitive absolute as intensifier with Niphal)
Niphal passive: to be fined or punished, to suffer a penalty (Ex 21:22, Pr 22:3, 27:12)
